column3: Menardi has the Stars and\nyour friends. She's waiting\non the road below Imil.{end_wait}
Where? Where is Jenna!?{end_wait}
Out of your reach until\nthis is finished, and I'm\nsorry for that.{end_wait}
Sorry doesn't change\nanything. You took her from\nus.{end_wait}
Then follow us. I won't\nstop you again.{end_wait}
Wait, where's Mia? She went\nafter Menardi alone!{end_wait}
Then we'd better hurry. She\ncan't take on Menardi by\nherself!{end_wait}
...{end_wait}
She's already gone ahead.\nCome on, we have to catch\nup!{end_wait}
Menardi! Let them go.\nThey have done nothing\nto deserve this.{end_wait}
You came alone, healer.\nThat was a mistake.{end_wait}
Please... Don't let\nher take us!{end_wait}
Stay behind me.\nI won't let her hurt you.{end_wait}
You lit Mercury's beacon.\nNow you threaten children.\nI won't stand aside.{end_wait}
Then you will fall\nwith the rest of them.{end_wait}
Not while I can\nstill stand.{end_wait}
You held me back.\nBut you cannot win\nagainst me alone.{end_wait}
The Stars are ours.\nThe hostages come with us.\nDo not follow.{end_wait}
Mia! You're wounded.\nCan you walk?{end_wait}
I couldn't save them.\nMenardi took the Stars\nand the captives.{end_wait}
Then we go after them.\nTogether this time.{end_wait}
I thought I could\nprotect them alone.{page_break}I was wrong.\nLet's go together.{end_wait}
